assembly_order: Disconnect and remove battery source,including permanently-live monitor/balance feed; S0 off alone is not a service isolation claim
Bare P0 structure with battery support and neck/tail supports. MAIN bench-soldered/insulated and bolted before S0; access bolt nuts from below
Install lower actual-hole board supports/Pi/BUS/monitor before upper boards and bank. Mount source F0/XT60/S0/manualS1 with terminal/short-lead protection
Fit PWM/AUX boards and distribution tie rails on actual attachment axes; preserve hot-board clearance and connector access
Install R47 bank and both sides of fourMTA. Bench-prepare ends,wire connected groups,leave labelled slack and access for securing ties
Install upper soft bundles with replaceable ties; fit head/tail/leg cable exits and exercise prescribed digital ranges after final wire geometry
Fit only necessary local/lower guards. For repair remove neighbour module or replace ties,not independent complete-cassette removal
Phase2 print/dry-fit/trim/polarity and controlled electrical acceptance after E3 selection. No energizing in this task

blockers.missing: Guaranteed prospective source fault current or defensible minimum complete-loop impedance.
blockers.known: Selected pack manufacturer gives30C, no fault-current upper bound. At12.6V,1000A comparison needs>=0.0126ohm.
blockers.next: Obtain exact pack source bound; analyze each protected loop with guaranteed data. Do not short pack or infer from charger IR.

blockers.missing: Exact delivered factory lead copper area, insulation limit and connector contact evidence.
blockers.next: Identify documented cable/contact revision or revise to documented replacement harness; ISO test cable size is not a cable certificate.

blockers.missing: F0 clearing/let-through versus thinner branch before its own fuse.
blockers.known: Insulated short/restrained routing and<=50mm rule preserved, not thermal qualification.
blockers.next: Use source bound plus guaranteed total-clearing data and wire limit; evaluate physical assembly with current-limited supply, never deliberate LiPo short.

blockers.missing: Actual DC switched servo/SMPS inrush and reverse-energy behavior; guaranteed output fault-current envelope.
blockers.next: Retain manualS1 and separate rails; cannot transfer S821D or AC motor rating to S821. No invented limiter/clamp.

electrical_data_check.decision: Continue independent mechanical and wiring preparation; do not invent guaranteed fault-current,wire ampacity,total-clearing/inrush data or count E3 complete

estimate_confidence: Planning range,not a deadline promise: 9–16h independent implementation/reconciliation plus 3–8h integration reserve =12–24h active work. Supplier-data wait excluded;100% cannot be promised while E3 is blocked.
next_action: After new user approval,stage2 one common mount/support set at frozen current datums,including correction of the retained MAIN master expression before regeneration. Do not start stage2 in this closed hook window.
